From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-discovery: Technical deep dive (60-90 min) + proposed agenda

Hi Jordan / Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really appreciate the context on your clinical workflows and scale targets. Per our discussion, the next best step is a 60-90 minute technical deep dive with your ML and infra teams so our SEs can walk through:

- Integration patterns (API vs. Private deployment)
- Expected throughput and latency targets for inference
- Data security, retention, and key management requirements
- Model choices, quantization/latency tradeoffs, and rollout strategy
- Mutual action plan and timeline for a pilot

Proposed attendees from your side: ML lead, infra/infra architect, security lead (if available), and whoever owns procurement for contract/timing conversations. From Redwood: me (AM), Camila (Solutions Engineer), and a backend engineer (if helpful).

Proposed time slots (PT):
- Tue Aug 24: 10:00-11:30 or 14:00-15:30
- Wed Aug 25: 09:00-10:30 or 13:00-14:30

Please confirm which slot works or suggest alternatives. I attached a brief agenda and a mutual action plan to give structure to the session.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the right folks on the call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Please include sample QPS and 95th percentile latency targets per endpoint (even a ballpark range is helpful).
- List any model families you expect us to evaluate (open LLMs vs. hosted variants) and expected sequence lengths.
- If you plan to evaluate Private deployment, please include details on VPC egress rules and KMS provider.

I'll join the call as SE and plan to demo a small integration pattern (API + caching) and a short run-through of dedicated vs private tradeoffs.
